questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows rules that drivers must follow. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are driving the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the roadway. Drive with extra caution in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that traffic patterns or routes have changed due to a work zone. Follow the detour indicated.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful. This sign tells you that construction work is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means that large trucks are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to slow down when the road is wet because it may be slippery and harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that lanes are moving or changing direction. Be aware and follow the new lane path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane will leave the highway on a ramp. You must either change lanes to continue through the interchange or you must exit the highway if you stay in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to stay alert and be ready to stop if a hazard appears ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height of an overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height listed on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you not to block the intersection ahead. Be careful not to stop your vehicle in the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be present on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left ahead. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign alerts drivers that a detour is ahead and normal routes will be redirected.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers about a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid brake damage or collisions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if it is safe to do so to help traffic enter the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway begins ahead with two separate one-way roads. Keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps to tell you not to proceed in your current direction.
